name: At-Turaif District in ad-Dir'iyah
description: At-Turaif is a hilltop district of mud-brick palaces and walled lanes on the edge of the Diriyah oasis, northwest of Riyadh in Saudi Arabia. It served as the first capital of the House of Saud from 1727 until the Ottomans took it in 1818. Its sand-coloured ruins show the Najdi style of central Arabia, and visitors can wander among the remains of many palaces.
